title: Duty/standby pump alternation (lead rotation)
nl_spec: Two pumps share a duty in a lead/standby arrangement. While there is a Demand (and the system is healthy), exactly one pump - the current lead pump - runs. Each time the demand ends, the lead role alternates to the other pump so wear is shared. Use an internal INT Lead (0 = pump 1 leads, 1 = pump 2 leads) and an internal BOOL PrevDemand to detect the end (falling edge) of demand. The emergency stop EStop is normally-closed (TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated) and stops both pumps. SAFETY: the two pumps must never run at the same time, and a pump only runs while there is demand. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named pump_alt with inputs Demand, EStop and outputs Pump1, Pump2.

interface.name: EStop
interface.description: Emergency stop, normally-closed: TRUE = healthy, FALSE = activated

safety_properties.nl: The two pumps never run at the same time.
On emergency stop, both pumps are off.
A pump only runs while there is demand.

scenarios.description: Alternate lead on each demand cycle

notes: Lead read for outputs uses the pre-toggle (previous) value; lead toggles on the falling edge of Demand; PrevDemand updated last each scan.
